payload.description_html:
Otoliths (ear stones) are small calcareous structures found in the heads of fish. The otolith is an important tool for understanding the lives of fish and their populations.

Growth rings record the age and growth of a fish, from the date of hatching to the time of death. Growth rings form and record in detail the age and growth patterns. They are visible to the naked eye but special preparation must be made for optimal reading.
